The atomic number is the proton number. Neutrality additionally makes electron number equal to proton number.

questionBank.Subject: biology
questionBank.Text: An animal cell and its surrounding solution are isotonic. What is true of water movement?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["No water molecule crosses the membrane","Water moves both ways with no net flux","Water enters but never leaves","The cell must immediately lyse","All water leaves the cell"]
questionBank.Explanation:
پاسخ صحیح: Water moves both ways with no net flux
At osmotic equilibrium the bidirectional fluxes balance, rather than molecular movement stopping.

questionBank.Subject: biology
questionBank.Text: A is completely dominant over a. For the cross AA × aa, what fraction of offspring are expected to show the dominant phenotype?
questionBank.Explanation:
پاسخ صحیح: 1
List gametes and combine them in a Punnett square. A dominant phenotype requires at least one A allele.

questionBank.Subject: biology
questionBank.Text: Producers contain 3000 kJ available energy. If 10% transfers to primary consumers, how much energy reaches those consumers in kJ?
questionBank.Explanation:
پاسخ صحیح: 300
With an explicitly given 10% transfer efficiency, multiply the preceding trophic level's energy by 0.1.

questionBank.Subject: biology
questionBank.Text: After a meal, blood glucose rises from its fasting level by 3 units. Which hormone normally promotes glucose uptake and storage?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Melatonin","Insulin","Glucagon","Thyroxine","ADH"]
questionBank.Explanation:
پاسخ صحیح: Insulin
Pancreatic beta cells secrete insulin in response to raised glucose; its effects help lower blood glucose.

questionBank.Subject: chemistry
questionBank.Text: A 40 g solid absorbs 8000 J while melting at constant temperature. What is its latent heat of fusion?

questionBank.Subject: chemistry
questionBank.Text: Which process involves chemical changes during souring?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Cutting paper into pieces","milk souring","Pure ice melting","Sugar dissolving in water","Crushing a salt crystal"]
questionBank.Explanation: ترش‌شدن شیر با تشکیل گونه‌هایی مانند اسید لاکتیک همراه است.

questionBank.Subject: chemistry
questionBank.Text: What directly produces the pressure of a gas on its container walls?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["The color of the container","Collisions of gas particles with the walls","Only gravitational attraction","A complete absence of particle motion","The chemical identity of the gas"]
questionBank.Explanation: برخورد ذرات با دیواره تکانه منتقل می‌کند و فشار می‌سازد.

questionBank.Subject: chemistry
questionBank.Text: Which method recovers a nonvolatile dissolved salt when collecting the solvent is not required?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Magnetic separation","Evaporation","Centrifugation without precipitating the salt","Filtration through ordinary filter paper after adding more water","Sieving"]
questionBank.Explanation: با تبخیر حلال، نمک غیرفرار باقی می‌ماند.

questionBank.Subject: chemistry
questionBank.Text: A sealed vessel contains 40 g A and 20 g B. After reaction, 10 g A remains and only C forms. All B is consumed. What mass of C forms?
questionBank.Explanation: جرم A مصرفی 30 g و B مصرفی 20 g؛ جرم C برابر 50 g.

questionBank.Subject: biology
questionBank.Topic: ۱ماده و انرژی: اتم، ایزوتوپ، الکترون ظرفیت و پیوندها
questionBank.Text: A neutral atom has atomic number 9. How many protons does it have?
questionBank.Explanation:
پاسخ صحیح: 9
The atomic number is the proton number. Neutrality additionally makes electron number equal to proton number.

questionBank.Subject: biology
questionBank.Text: A plant cell loses water in a hypertonic solution. Which change is expected?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Water moves against its gradient without energy","The cell necessarily bursts from water entry","The vacuole gains volume as the cell loses water","The cell wall dissolves instantly","The membrane can pull away from the cell wall"]
questionBank.Explanation:
پاسخ صحیح: The membrane can pull away from the cell wall
Osmotic loss of water reduces turgor and may produce plasmolysis.

questionBank.Subject: biology
questionBank.Text: A is completely dominant over a. For the cross Aa × Aa, what fraction of offspring are expected to show the dominant phenotype?
questionBank.Explanation:
پاسخ صحیح: 3/4
List gametes and combine them in a Punnett square. A dominant phenotype requires at least one A allele.

questionBank.Subject: biology
questionBank.Text: Producers contain 4000 kJ available energy. If 10% transfers to primary consumers, how much energy reaches those consumers in kJ?
questionBank.Explanation:
پاسخ صحیح: 400
With an explicitly given 10% transfer efficiency, multiply the preceding trophic level's energy by 0.1.

questionBank.Subject: biology
questionBank.Text: After a meal, blood glucose rises from its fasting level by 4 units. Which hormone normally promotes glucose uptake and storage?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["ADH","Melatonin","Insulin","Glucagon","Thyroxine"]
questionBank.Explanation:
پاسخ صحیح: Insulin
Pancreatic beta cells secrete insulin in response to raised glucose; its effects help lower blood glucose.

questionBank.Subject: logic
questionBank.Topic: 🧠 Logic Cheat Sheet — چکیده‌ی فشرده‌ی کل جزوه
questionBank.Text: Given P→Q and not Q, which conclusion is valid?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["P","Q","P and Q","Not P"]
questionBank.Explanation: Modus tollens: if P held then Q would hold, contradicting not Q.

questionBank.Subject: logic
questionBank.Topic: 🧠 Logic Cheat Sheet — چکیده‌ی فشرده‌ی کل جزوه
questionBank.Text: What is the negation of 'Every student solved at least one exercise'?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Some students solved at least one exercise","No student exists","At least one student solved no exercises","Every student solved no exercises"]
questionBank.Explanation: Negating ∀x∃y P(x,y) gives ∃x∀y not P(x,y).

questionBank.Subject: logic
questionBank.Topic: 🧠 Logic Cheat Sheet — چکیده‌ی فشرده‌ی کل جزوه
questionBank.Text: Sales rose from 80 to 100 units. What was the percentage increase?
questionBank.Explanation: Percentage change uses the original value as denominator: (100−80)/80×100=25%.

questionBank.Subject: logic
questionBank.Topic: فصل ۶: سازگاری و ناسازگاری — Consistency vs Inconsistency
questionBank.Text: Premises: Every class member passed the exam. Tom is a class member. Tom did not pass the exam. Is this set consistent?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Yes, because Tom might be absent","Yes, because universal claims have no exceptions","It depends on Tom's grade","No; it entails both 'Tom passed' and 'Tom did not pass'"]
questionBank.Explanation: Instantiating the universal premise with Tom yields a direct contradiction.

questionBank.Subject: reading
questionBank.Text: Read: "The garden offers more than fresh food. Neighbours exchange advice there, and children learn how plants grow." Which summary best preserves the main idea?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["The garden has several social and educational benefits.","All children are expert gardeners.","The garden is open only to children.","Advice is more expensive than food.","The garden produces no food."]
questionBank.Explanation: Both sentences support benefits beyond food: cooperation and learning. The alternatives introduce unsupported restrictions or contradictions.

questionBank.Subject: reading
questionBank.Text: Read: "The curator moved the glass plates away from the window. This protected them from direct sunlight." What does "them" refer to?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["The windows","The curators","The glass plates","The visitors","The sun rays"]
questionBank.Explanation: The glass plates are the objects moved and protected. The pronoun keeps the same plural object reference.

questionBank.Subject: reading
questionBank.Text: Read: "Owen brought an umbrella although the morning sky was clear. By noon, several people were sheltering in the doorway, but he walked across the square." Which inference is best supported?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["No one else owned an umbrella.","It rained throughout the morning.","Owen was prepared for the later rain.","Owen knew the exact weather forecast.","The square was closed to everyone else."]
questionBank.Explanation: The umbrella and the contrast with people sheltering support preparedness for rain, without proving how he predicted it.

questionBank.Subject: reading
questionBank.Text: Read: "The committee called the first results tentative and asked for another trial before deciding." Here "tentative" most nearly means:
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Provisional","Deliberately false","Unusually expensive","Final and certain","Unrelated to the trial"]
questionBank.Explanation: The request for another trial before a decision shows that the results are provisional, not a final basis for certainty.

questionBank.Subject: reading
questionBank.Text: Read: "The new system could reduce queues, but the small trial cannot yet tell us whether it will work at every branch." Which tone best fits?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Humorous and mocking","Cautiously optimistic","Angry and accusatory","Certain and triumphant","Completely dismissive"]
questionBank.Explanation: The writer acknowledges a possible benefit while limiting the conclusion to what a small trial can establish.

questionBank.Subject: reading
questionBank.Text: Read: "The walk is short. However, the path is steep and may take longer than expected." What is the role of "However"?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["It introduces the cause of the walk being short.","It gives another example of a short walk.","It marks an unrelated change of topic.","It proves the path is flat.","It introduces a qualification of the expectation raised by the first sentence."]
questionBank.Explanation: A short distance may suggest a quick walk; the steepness qualifies that expectation. The second sentence remains about the same walk.

questionBank.Subject: reading
questionBank.Text: Read: "Sales rose after the shop changed its sign, so the sign caused the increase." Which new fact most weakens this causal inference?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["The sign was visible from the road.","A nearby competitor closed during the same week.","The sign used blue lettering.","The owner liked the new sign.","Sales were recorded every day."]
questionBank.Explanation: A competitor closing is an alternative explanation for higher sales. It weakens attributing the entire increase to the sign without proving the sign had no effect.

questionBank.Subject: reading
questionBank.Topic: خواندن متن غیرداستانی، ادبی و خبری
questionBank.Text: Read: "According to the transport office, repairs will finish on Friday. The newspaper has not independently confirmed the estimate." Which interpretation is justified?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["The transport office denies any repairs.","Friday is an attributed estimate, not an independently established fact.","The newspaper says Friday is impossible.","Friday is guaranteed by the newspaper.","The repairs have already finished."]
questionBank.Explanation: The report distinguishes a named source's forecast from independently confirmed information. Lack of confirmation does not establish falsity.

questionBank.Subject: math
questionBank.Text: A price of 100 units is reduced by 20% and then increased by 20%. What is the final price?
questionBank.Explanation: After the reduction the price is 100 x 0.8 = 80. The increase gives 80 x 1.2 = 96.

questionBank.Subject: math
questionBank.Text: For real x, which expression always equals sqrt(x^2)?
questionBank.Explanation: The principal square root is non-negative. Therefore sqrt(x^2) is the absolute value of x, including when x is negative.

questionBank.Subject: math
questionBank.Text: What is the remainder when 47 is divided by 6?

questionBank.Subject: math
questionBank.Text: What is the solution set of x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0 over the real numbers?

questionBank.Subject: math
questionBank.Text: Which real values satisfy -2x > 6?
questionBank.Explanation: Dividing by -2 reverses the inequality, giving x < -3.

questionBank.Subject: math
questionBank.Text: If x + y = 7 and x - y = 1, what is x?
questionBank.Explanation: Adding the equations gives 2x = 8, hence x = 4; then y = 3.

questionBank.Subject: math
questionBank.Text: What is the distance between (1, 2) and (4, 6)?
questionBank.Explanation: The coordinate differences are 3 and 4; the distance is sqrt(3^2+4^2) = 5.

questionBank.Subject: math
questionBank.Text: Two similar solids have a corresponding length ratio of 2:1. What is their volume ratio?
questionBank.Explanation: Volume scales as the cube of a linear scale factor, so 2^3:1 = 8:1.

questionBank.Subject: math
questionBank.Text: Which circle has centre (2, -1) and radius 3?
questionBank.Explanation: Substitute a=2, b=-1 and r=3 in (x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2.

questionBank.Subject: math
questionBank.Text: Let f(x)=2x+1 and g(x)=x^2. What is f(g(3))?

questionBank.Subject: math
questionBank.Text: What is the real domain of h(x)=1/(x-2)?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["x > 2 only","All real numbers except 0","All real numbers except 2","All real numbers","x >= 2 only"]
questionBank.Explanation: The denominator cannot be zero, so only x=2 is excluded.

questionBank.Subject: math
questionBank.Text: Compared with y=x^2, the graph y=(x+3)^2 is shifted:
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["3 units down","3 units left","9 units up","3 units right","3 units up"]
questionBank.Explanation: Replacing x with x+3 shifts the graph three units left; its vertex is (-3,0).

questionBank.Subject: math
questionBank.Text: What is log_2(8)?
questionBank.Explanation: By definition, log_2(8)=3 because 2^3=8.

questionBank.Subject: math
questionBank.Text: What real x satisfies log_2(x-1)=3?
questionBank.Explanation: x-1=2^3=8, so x=9, which satisfies x>1.

questionBank.Subject: math
questionBank.Text: Which values satisfy (1/2)^x > 1/4?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["x > 4","x < 2","x > 2","x = 2 only","All real x"]
questionBank.Explanation: 1/4=(1/2)^2 and exponentiation with base 1/2 is strictly decreasing, so x<2.

questionBank.Subject: math
questionBank.Text: How many two-person teams can be selected from five distinct people?
questionBank.Explanation: Order does not matter: C(5,2)=5 x 4/2=10.

questionBank.Subject: math
questionBank.Text: A fair coin is tossed twice independently. What is the probability of two heads?
questionBank.Explanation: The two independent probabilities multiply: (1/2)(1/2)=1/4.

questionBank.Subject: math
questionBank.Text: A fair six-sided die is rolled once. What is the probability of obtaining 1 or 2?
questionBank.Explanation: The two disjoint favourable outcomes out of six equally likely outcomes give 2/6=1/3.

questionBank.Subject: math
questionBank.Text: What is the median of 2, 3, 3, 4 and 18?
questionBank.Explanation: The data are already ordered; the third of five values is 3.

questionBank.Subject: math
questionBank.Text: Ten of forty observations belong to category A. What is the relative frequency of A?
questionBank.Explanation: Relative frequency = 10/40 = 0.25.

questionBank.Subject: math
questionBank.Text: Which variable is measured on a nominal scale?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Temperature in kelvin","Distance in metres","Eye colour category","Time elapsed in seconds","Mass in kilograms"]
questionBank.Explanation: Eye colour consists of unordered categories. The other quantities listed use ratio scales.

questionBank.Subject: logic
questionBank.Text: All club members have a card. Lina is a club member. Which conclusion must follow?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Every card belongs to Lina","No non-member has a card","Everyone with a card is a member","Lina is the only member","Lina has a card"]
questionBank.Explanation: Universal instantiation applies the rule to Lina. The converse and exclusivity claims are not given.

questionBank.Subject: logic
questionBank.Text: What is the logical negation of "Every room is bright"?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Every room is dark","No room is bright","At least one room is bright","Exactly one room is bright","At least one room is not bright"]
questionBank.Explanation: The negation of a universal statement is an existential counterexample: at least one room is not bright.

questionBank.Subject: logic
questionBank.Text: Which statement is logically equivalent to "If P, then Q"?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["If not P, then not Q","If Q, then P","If not Q, then not P","P and Q","P or Q"]
questionBank.Explanation: A conditional is equivalent to its contrapositive, not its converse or inverse.

questionBank.Subject: logic
questionBank.Text: If submitting form F is necessary for registration R, which implication is valid?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["F is impossible","R implies F","Not R implies not F","F implies R","F and R are incompatible"]
questionBank.Explanation: A necessary condition must hold whenever the outcome holds: registration implies submission.

questionBank.Subject: logic
questionBank.Text: In classical first-order logic, "All unicorns are blue" alone entails which claim?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["No unicorn is non-blue","Every blue thing is a unicorn","Exactly one unicorn exists","At least one unicorn exists","No blue thing exists"]
questionBank.Explanation: The universal claim rules out a non-blue unicorn but does not imply that any unicorn exists.

questionBank.Subject: logic
questionBank.Text: A share rises from 20% to 30%. What is the increase in percentage points?
questionBank.Explanation: Percentage-point change is 30 - 20 = 10. Relative percentage growth would instead be 50%.

questionBank.Subject: logic
questionBank.Text: Ten students average 8 points and thirty students average 4 points. What is the combined mean?
questionBank.Explanation: Total points are 10 x 8 + 30 x 4 = 200 across 40 students; the mean is 5.

questionBank.Subject: logic
questionBank.Text: Group A has 100 people, 30% of whom cycle. Group B has 40 people, 50% of whom cycle. Which group has more cyclists?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Group B, by 20","Both have 30","Group A, by 10","Group B, by 10","Both have 50"]
questionBank.Explanation: A has 30 cyclists and B has 20. A has ten more despite its lower percentage.

questionBank.Subject: logic
questionBank.Text: A survey finds that people who use a study app have higher marks. What follows from this observation alone?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["The app lowers marks","The app certainly causes higher marks","All high-scoring students use the app","No other factors can matter","App use and marks are associated in the surveyed sample"]
questionBank.Explanation: An observational association does not establish causation; self-selection and other factors may explain it.

questionBank.Subject: logic
questionBank.Text: A bar chart starts its vertical axis at 90 rather than 0. Which precaution is most appropriate?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Conclude the underlying data must be false","Ignore the axis and compare visible heights only","Assume all bars represent zero","Read the labelled values before judging the size of differences","Treat every difference as 90 units"]
questionBank.Explanation: A truncated axis can exaggerate apparent differences. Reading values and the scale avoids that visual error.

questionBank.Subject: logic
questionBank.Text: A trip costs 12 units plus 3 units per kilometre. What is the cost for 5 kilometres?
questionBank.Explanation: C = 12 + 3d; with d=5 the cost is 12 + 15 = 27.

questionBank.Subject: logic
questionBank.Text: Of 30 people, 18 know language A, 15 know B, and 8 know both. How many know neither?
questionBank.Explanation: The union has 18+15-8=25 people; 30-25=5 know neither.

questionBank.Subject: logic
questionBank.Text: A printer produces 12 pages per minute at a constant rate. How long does it take to produce 90 pages?
questionBank.Explanation: Time = pages/rate = 90/12 = 7.5 minutes.

questionBank.Subject: logic
questionBank.Text: A mixture uses red and blue beads in the ratio 2:3. If there are 20 red beads, how many blue beads are needed?
questionBank.Explanation: The scale factor from 2 to 20 is 10, so blue beads = 3 x 10 = 30.

questionBank.Subject: logic
questionBank.Text: A model predicts that 4.5 buses are required to carry a group, and partial buses cannot be hired. What is the smallest feasible number of buses?
questionBank.Explanation: The capacity requirement must be rounded upward to a whole bus: five. Rounding down would leave insufficient capacity.

questionBank.Subject: biology
questionBank.Text: Which property makes phospholipids suitable for forming cell-membrane bilayers?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["They are chains of amino acids","They contain only non-polar regions","They are identical to DNA nucleotides","They have no interaction with water","They contain hydrophilic heads and hydrophobic tails"]
questionBank.Explanation:
پاسخ صحیح: They contain hydrophilic heads and hydrophobic tails
Their amphipathic structure favours heads facing water and tails facing inward, forming a bilayer.

questionBank.Subject: biology
questionBank.Text: The primary structure of a protein is its:
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["membrane location","amino-acid sequence","arrangement of multiple subunits","overall three-dimensional shape","rate of synthesis"]
questionBank.Explanation:
پاسخ صحیح: amino-acid sequence
Primary structure is the linear amino-acid sequence linked by peptide bonds.

questionBank.Subject: biology
questionBank.Text: Which set lists the components of a nucleotide?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Only sugar and water","Fatty acid, sugar and protein","Base, lipid and amino acid","Sugar, phosphate and nitrogenous base","Amino acid, glycerol and phosphate"]
questionBank.Explanation:
پاسخ صحیح: Sugar, phosphate and nitrogenous base
A nucleotide contains a pentose sugar, phosphate and a nitrogenous base.

questionBank.Subject: biology
questionBank.Topic: ۱انواع سلول: پروکاریوت، یوکاریوت، گیاهی و جانوری
questionBank.Text: Which structure is present in both typical bacterial cells and animal cells?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["A large central vacuole","A membrane-bound nucleus","A cellulose cell wall","A chloroplast","A ribosome"]
questionBank.Explanation:
پاسخ صحیح: A ribosome
Ribosomes occur in both prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells; the other structures are not shared by typical bacteria and animals.

questionBank.Subject: biology
questionBank.Topic: ۳هسته، ریبوزوم، سامانهٔ اندوممبران و اسکلت سلولی
questionBank.Text: Which organelle modifies and sorts many proteins arriving from the endoplasmic reticulum?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Chloroplast","Golgi apparatus","Centriole","Nucleolus","Cell wall"]
questionBank.Explanation:
پاسخ صحیح: Golgi apparatus
The Golgi apparatus receives ER cargo, modifies it and sorts it into transport routes.

questionBank.Subject: biology
questionBank.Text: Which statement about a typical photosynthetic plant cell is correct?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["It has chloroplasts but no mitochondria","Its cell wall replaces its plasma membrane","It can contain both chloroplasts and mitochondria","Its DNA exists only in chloroplasts","It contains no ribosomes"]
questionBank.Explanation:
پاسخ صحیح: It can contain both chloroplasts and mitochondria
Photosynthetic plant cells can have both organelles. They also retain a plasma membrane, ribosomes and nuclear DNA.

questionBank.Subject: biology
questionBank.Text: For a single Mendelian locus with complete dominance, Aa x Aa produces what probability of genotype aa?
questionBank.Explanation:
پاسخ صحیح: 1/4
Each parent contributes allele a with probability 1/2; the independent gamete combination gives 1/4.

questionBank.Subject: biology
questionBank.Text: During which stage is nuclear DNA replicated before a typical mitotic division?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Metaphase","S phase","G1","Cytokinesis","Telophase"]
questionBank.Explanation:
پاسخ صحیح: S phase
DNA replication occurs in S phase of interphase, before mitosis.

questionBank.Subject: biology
questionBank.Text: Translation directly produces a:
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Lipid bilayer","New nucleus","DNA chromosome","Polypeptide","Starch granule"]
questionBank.Explanation:
پاسخ صحیح: Polypeptide
Ribosomes translate mRNA codons into an amino-acid chain, a polypeptide.

questionBank.Subject: biology
questionBank.Topic: ۳انتقال در گیاه: آب، قند و مواد معدنی
questionBank.Text: Which plant tissue primarily transports water and dissolved mineral ions from roots?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Xylem","Pollen","Epidermis","Phloem","Cambium only"]
questionBank.Explanation:
پاسخ صحیح: Xylem
Xylem is the principal long-distance pathway for water and mineral ions from roots.

questionBank.Subject: biology
questionBank.Text: The oxygen released during oxygenic photosynthesis originates directly from:
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["soil minerals","carbon dioxide","glucose","nitrogen gas","water"]
questionBank.Explanation:
پاسخ صحیح: water
Water is split during the light-dependent reactions, releasing molecular oxygen.

questionBank.Subject: biology
questionBank.Text: An interaction benefits both participating species. It is classified as:
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["mutualism","parasitism","competition","commensalism","predation"]
questionBank.Explanation:
پاسخ صحیح: mutualism
Mutualism denotes a +/+ interaction. Commensalism is +/0 and parasitism is +/- in the simplified classification.

questionBank.Subject: biology
questionBank.Text: An artery is defined as a blood vessel that:
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["always carries blood towards the heart","exists only in the lungs","contains no muscle","always carries oxygen-rich blood","carries blood away from the heart"]
questionBank.Explanation:
پاسخ صحیح: carries blood away from the heart
Direction relative to the heart defines arteries. Pulmonary arteries show why oxygen content is not the definition.

questionBank.Subject: biology
questionBank.Text: In a healthy human, most absorption of digested nutrients occurs in the:
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["oesophagus","trachea","stomach","small intestine","urinary bladder"]
questionBank.Explanation:
پاسخ صحیح: small intestine
The small intestine provides a large absorptive surface through folds, villi and microvilli.

questionBank.Subject: biology
questionBank.Text: Which tissue type is specialised for contraction?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Epithelial","Muscle","Connective","Nervous","Cartilage"]
questionBank.Explanation:
پاسخ صحیح: Muscle
Muscle tissue generates force through contraction; the other categories have different principal roles.

questionBank.Subject: chemistry
questionBank.Text: A mixture contains insoluble sand and dissolved sodium chloride. Which sequence separates sand and recovers salt from the filtrate?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Evaporate, then filter the dry solid","Filter, then evaporate water from the filtrate","Filter the dissolved salt directly","Use a magnet, then freeze the liquid","Decant the salt crystals before any water is removed"]
questionBank.Explanation: صافی شن را می‌گیرد؛ تبخیر حلال نمک را باقی می‌گذارد.

questionBank.Subject: chemistry
questionBank.Text: In a sealed vessel, 12.0 g of carbon reacts completely with 32.0 g of oxygen to form only carbon dioxide. What mass of carbon dioxide forms?
questionBank.Explanation: جرم CO2=12+32=44 g در واکنش کامل.

questionBank.Subject: chemistry
questionBank.Text: Two ideal molecular gases occupy equal volumes at the same temperature and pressure. They must have equal:
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["total masses","molecular masses","numbers of atoms per molecule","numbers of molecules","mass densities"]
questionBank.Explanation: گازهای ایده‌آل با حجم، دما و فشار برابر مقدار مول و تعداد ذرات برابر دارند.

questionBank.Subject: chemistry
questionBank.Text: Which statement correctly compares the molecular shapes of CO2 and H2O?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Both are linear","CO2 is linear and H2O is bent","CO2 is bent and H2O is linear","Both are trigonal planar","Both are tetrahedral"]
questionBank.Explanation: CO2 دو ناحیه و هندسه خطی دارد؛ آب دو پیوند و دو جفت تنها و هندسه خمیده.

questionBank.Subject: chemistry
questionBank.Text: What is the electrically neutral formula formed from Al3+ and O2- ions?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Al3O2","AlO","AlO3","Al2O3","Al2O"]
questionBank.Explanation: دو Al³⁺ و سه O²⁻ بار صفر می‌دهند.

questionBank.Subject: chemistry
questionBank.Text: Which pure substance can form an extended network of hydrogen bonds between its own molecules?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Carbon tetrachloride, CCl4","Hydrogen, H2","Water, H2O","Methane, CH4","Carbon dioxide, CO2"]
questionBank.Explanation: آب دهنده O–H و پذیرنده جفت تنها دارد؛ سایر گزینه‌ها دهنده متعارف ندارند.

questionBank.Subject: chemistry
questionBank.Text: A neutral atom of chlorine-37 has atomic number 17. How many neutrons does it contain?

questionBank.Subject: chemistry
questionBank.Text: What is the maximum number of electrons in one atomic orbital?
questionBank.Explanation: طبق پائولی دو الکترون با اسپین مخالف در هر اوربیتال مجاز است.

questionBank.Subject: chemistry
questionBank.Text: Which atom has the largest atomic radius among Li, Na and K under the usual periodic trend?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["The trend cannot distinguish these elements","Li","Na","K","All three have equal radius"]
questionBank.Explanation: با پایین رفتن گروه ۱، پوسته اضافه و شعاع معمولاً بزرگ‌تر می‌شود.

questionBank.Subject: chemistry
questionBank.Text: For 2H2 + O2 -> 2H2O, a mixture has 3.0 mol H2 and 2.0 mol O2. What is the theoretical amount of water?

questionBank.Subject: reading
questionBank.Text: Which statement best expresses the central argument of "A library of useful things"?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Sharing objects works best when maintenance and access are carefully organised.","A larger collection always attracts more borrowers.","Online reservation is essential for any library.","Repair costs make all sharing schemes uneconomic.","Every household should stop buying equipment immediately."]
questionBank.Explanation: The text recognises savings but makes success depend on maintenance and practical access; none of the absolute alternatives is supported.

questionBank.Subject: reading
questionBank.Text: Why did the organisers limit the range of equipment in "A library of useful things"?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["They wished to replace the local book library.","They expected every household to own a drill.","They had banned all donated items.","They wanted a collection they could reliably maintain.","They could open only in the morning."]
questionBank.Explanation: The maintenance discussion leads directly to choosing a small, robust collection rather than accepting every donation.

questionBank.Subject: reading
questionBank.Text: In "A library of useful things", what does "These changes" refer to?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Replacing all worn-out equipment","Charging a larger membership fee","Closing the online reservation system","Buying more drills and kitchen equipment","Evening opening and telephone reservations"]
questionBank.Explanation: The preceding sentence pair describes evening opening and telephone booking; the text explicitly says object numbers did not increase.

questionBank.Subject: reading
questionBank.Text: In "A library of useful things", "robust equipment" most nearly means equipment that is:
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["fashionable","digital","durable","expensive","unfamiliar"]
questionBank.Explanation: A limited maintenance budget motivates choosing durable equipment that can withstand repeated use.

questionBank.Subject: reading
questionBank.Text: Which inference is best supported by "A library of useful things"?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Every donated object is unsafe.","Sharing requires no paid or volunteer labour.","Practical arrangements can improve access without enlarging the collection.","All borrowers have access to online forms.","Evening opening eliminates all access barriers."]
questionBank.Explanation: The evening and telephone changes widened use while the number of objects stayed the same. The other claims go beyond the evidence.

questionBank.Subject: reading
questionBank.Text: What does Mara's repeated handling of the envelope in "The unopened envelope" suggest?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["She has forgotten her brother's name.","She cannot read the address.","She is uncertain about sending her reply.","She is sorting letters for the caf\u00e9 owner.","She is waiting for a stamp seller."]
questionBank.Explanation: Carrying the reply for three weeks and finding reasons to wait supports hesitation, not a practical postal obstacle.

questionBank.Subject: reading
questionBank.Text: Why is the brother's "reasonable question" significant in "The unopened envelope"?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Its calm practicality contrasts with Mara's emotional difficulty.","It makes her journey unnecessary.","It reveals an explicit accusation.","It shows that no household objects remain.","It proves the house has already been sold."]
questionBank.Explanation: The narrator explicitly contrasts the absence of accusation with how deeply the request unsettles Mara.

questionBank.Subject: reading
questionBank.Text: What can safely be concluded about the children in "The unopened envelope"?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["They are Mara's children.","They recognise Mara's brother.","They prevent her from reaching the platform.","They tell Mara what to write.","Their shared activity briefly holds Mara's attention."]
questionBank.Explanation: The narrative describes Mara watching them, but gives no family connection or direct influence on the added line.

questionBank.Subject: reading
questionBank.Text: What changes at the end of "The unopened envelope"?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Mara loses her list.","Mara deliberately acts on the reply she has been postponing.","Mara decides never to answer.","Mara buys the old house.","Mara takes the earlier train."]
questionBank.Explanation: She adds a line, seals the envelope and walks to the post box; this is a concrete action after habitual delay.

questionBank.Subject: reading
questionBank.Text: Which detail is not revealed in "The unopened envelope"?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Whether the house might be sold","What Mara writes in the added line","Whether Mara has a brother","Whether Mara visits a station","Whether an envelope exists"]
questionBank.Explanation: The text reports that she adds a line but never reveals its words. Inferring exact wording would exceed the evidence.

questionBank.Subject: reading
questionBank.Text: What did Bellford's trial establish in "A trial route, a cautious verdict"?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["The bus connected with all arriving trains.","There was some demand for the later bus.","Every resident supported expansion.","Winter operation had already been approved.","The service required no staff."]
questionBank.Explanation: The final paragraph limits the finding to some demand. Continuation, costs and other expansions remain unsettled.

questionBank.Subject: reading
questionBank.Text: How did average weekday use compare with the transport office's expectation?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["It was three passengers higher.","It was eighteen passengers lower.","It was three passengers lower.","It exactly matched the expectation.","It was fifteen passengers higher."]
questionBank.Explanation: The reported average is 18 and the expectation 15, giving 18 - 15 = 3 more passengers.

questionBank.Subject: reading
questionBank.Text: Why is the cost comparison still uncertain in the Bellford report?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["The traders opposed all bus services.","All trial vehicles were bought specially.","The trial used a vehicle returning to its depot, while continuation may require different staffing.","The town has no railway station.","No passenger numbers were recorded."]
questionBank.Explanation: The arrangement during the trial may not represent the costs of continuing the service; a comparison has not been published.

questionBank.Subject: reading
questionBank.Text: Why should the public meeting not be treated as a town-wide survey?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Attendance was voluntary and may not represent all residents.","The office asked for written responses.","It was held on a Tuesday.","The average passenger number was eighteen.","Residents spoke about transport."]
questionBank.Explanation: Voluntary attendance can select people with particular interests or strong opinions; it is not a representative sample.

questionBank.Subject: reading
questionBank.Text: Which best describes the Bellford report's tone?
questionBank.OptionsJson: ["Indifferent to evidence","Hostile towards passengers","Certain that the route must close","Cautious and evidence-focused","Unreservedly celebratory"]
questionBank.Explanation: The report acknowledges encouraging demand while identifying limits in cost evidence and representativeness.
